d:
Yoga guru Baba Ramdev launched a sharp attack on Dhirendra Krishna Shastri, popularly known as Bageshwar Baba.
The remarks were made on November 22 at a women’s conference organised by Mahila Patanjali Yog Samiti in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand.
Ramdev called some religious storytellers hypocrites and accused them of misleading people in the name of religion and ghost-related rituals.
He also criticised the comparison of Lord Ram and Lord Krishna, calling it disrespectful to Hindu deities.
Without naming Shastri directly, Ramdev’s remarks clearly appeared to target the Bageshwar Dham preacher.
